title: S1Uniform GATED:  the S1 UNIFORM statement + walk composition is the formal artifact (two-sided below G, dead-zone plunge s10 datum, one-sided E1-threat above G;  s1UniformAndWalk -> RH on the four walk legs;  full build 17450 green);  far-zeta wall probe still in flight at 9e18 (1h,  no OOM)
body: FORMAL  (S1Uniform.lean,  269  lines,  sorry-free,  full  build  17450  jobs  green;  ProbeS1U.lean  gate  probe  added;  cards  now  87).  P12.S1  carries  the  comment  'proven  pointwise  in  the  audited  bands;  uniform  height  =  open';  this  module  closes  the  uniform  side  of  that  comment  and  composes  it  with  the  walk,  in  three  parts.  Part  A  --  e1BelowGWholeFromSample:  on  the  below-G  face  domain  (G0,  GH]  the  wp  face  M_wp  is  FINITE  AND  C^1  (it  sums  only  FAR  zeros,  every  one  at  distance  >  G_LAST  -  t  from  any  row  at  or  below  G_LAST,  so  no  cusp  enters  below  G)  -  therefore  the  classical  TWO-SIDED  sample  ->  uniform  bridge  (S1Sample.sampleToUniform)  applies  to  M_wp  ITSELF,  with  NO  defect  subtraction:  row  face  +  Lipschitz  face  +  cover  =>  |M_wp  t|  <=  Bb  +  L1  *  Dv1  (the  scope-note  reduction  of  S1Sample  made  an  explicit  theorem).  Part  B  --  s1UniformFace  (the  shape)  +  s1UniformStatement  (proven):  the  FULL  program-domain  uniform  face  on  (G0,  T_MEAS]  as  ONE  named  object  -  (i)  TWO-SIDED  |M_wp|  <=  Bb  +  L1  *  Dv1  below  G;  (ii)  TWO-SIDED  |M_wp|  <=  Bdead  on  the  dead  zone  (GH,  G_LAST],  the  MEASURED  PLUNGE  (s10  dead-zone  march:  11  rows  over  0.94G  ..  1.0G,  max  |M_wp|  =  85772092.45510864,  new  Float  datum  BdeadData);  (iii)  ONE-SIDED  UPPER  (the  E1  threat  direction)  Mres  t  <=  B  +  L  Dv  +  C  .  n  .  log(1  +  Dv/eps)  above  G  -  the  face  truly  tends  to  -oo  at  the  super-G  zeros,  so  a  two-sided  full-domain  bound  is  NOT  the  right  shape  there  (two-sidedness  AT  the  rows  is  the  E1ClauseV3  datum).  Proved  by  pure  composition:  Part  A  +  the  hDead  datum  +  S1Cusp.e1CuspWholeFromRows.  Part  C  --  s1UniformAndWalk:  the  CHAIN.  Under  the  S1  uniform  premises  (which  carry  the  uniform  statement  -  certified  in  the  proof  body  as  the  local  declaration  hunif,  so  the  'uniform  height'  side  of  P12.S1  is  the  proven  part  of  the  chain),  the  named  DATA  clause  E1ClauseV3  q  7000  (the  E1  above-G  row  face,  21  measured  rows,  still  the  named  hole),  and  the  four  structural  walk  legs  hs1  -  hs4  on  P12.offPair  (exactly  as  if_E1V3_and_walk  takes  them),  RH  q  follows  on  any  structural  zero  set  -  pure  composition  through  E1C.if_E1V3_and_walk.  GATES  (ProbeS1U,  re-evaluated  live):  BdeadData  =  85772092.455109;  both  bridge  bounds  are  FORMAL  BUT  VACUOUS  at  the  measured  constants  -  below  G:  belowGUniformVacuous  =  7.8931e10  =  3.947e7  x  s8_Bcand  (2);  above  G:  bridgeAddData  =  6.5570002736e15  =  9.367e11  x  v3_Bcand  (7000)  -  so  the  operative  between-row  control  remains  the  cusp  face  robustness  and  the  P12  squeeze  leg,  unchanged.  The  NAMED  OPEN  ITEMS  of  the  programme  are  now  exactly:  the  data  faces  (row  faces,  L  faces,  covers,  dead  zone,  cusp  spacing  +  amplitude  bound)  and  E1ClauseV3  q  7000  itself.  No  RH  claim. DATA  (wall  probe):  the  fresh-process  RS-zeta  ladder  (tmp/zeta_fresh_wall.py,  PID  2986080)  is  still  computing  the  first  height  (t  =  9e18,  dps-40)  after  >  1  hour  at  a  FLAT  ~74  GB  RSS  -  no  OOM,  no  row  yet;  the  allocation  plateau  is  the  healthy  signature  (the  OOM  signature  was  linear  growth  to  117  GB).  The  probe  settles,  on  completion,  whether  the  s30  3e19  OOM  is  fundamental  (->  zeta-channel  replacement  for  the  extreme  rows)  or  a  residency  artifact  (->  resume  s30  for  the  1e9G/3e9G/1e10G  rows  at  t  =  3e19/9e19/3e20,  which  is  the  B7  leveraged  wall  at  3e20).  B7  remains  at  its  leveraged  wall  (t  ~  g0  ~  3e20  is  ~33x  past  the  verified  9e18  boundary  moved  by  s30).  No  RH  claim.
